name: KNR / KNNR — Norm Catalogues for Cost Estimation
description: Validates cost estimates against the KNR (Katalog Nakladow Rzeczowych) and KNNR (Kosztorysowe Normy Nakladow Rzeczowych) norm catalogues. Checks that BOQ items reference valid KNR/KNNR catalogue entries, that labour norms (roboczogodziny, r-g), material consumption norms, and equipment norms follow the catalogue tables, and that the kosztorys (estimate) structure conforms to the investor estimate regulation.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
